Piece P2 of the payment sheet split of #334 (3 pieces: #342 -> #343 -> #344). Base `agent115/sheet-split-1-payment-core`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 1 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#343 @ af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477
- Lines: 2438 changed (source 1951 / tests 487 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 6 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts` 1120, `src/components/__tests__` 467, `src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx` 416, `src/components/purchase` 415, `src/config/__tests__` 20.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#343 @ af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/5/0

Job AUD-SOL-P12-117, agent 117. Independent T4 native purchase/lifecycle/consent audit; no candidate-source edits.

### Prior findings / G09 applicability

All six P2 files are byte-identical to the original's Sol-approved `78ba9bc9a172f79fec5e7f8c3b0166acbf41dfe1`, except the two-line `pollPlan` post-read mount/attempt fence closing C-334-3; all six files and call sites were independently read, including newly live sheet wiring and piece boundaries. Prior B-334-3/4 amount/cadence/trial and unknown-native-result fixes remain present, but prior approval does not cover the counterexamples below or changed backend dependencies. ([Prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092), [exact P2 tree](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477), [post-read fence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L450-L499))

C-334-3 is **closed** for its demonstrated counterexample: its original failing-before log has one stale callback, while the independent held confirming-GET/unmount control now produces none; all 54 original subscription/recur3 controls execute successfully over this exact candidate runtime, not merely the unsplit original. Original B-334-3/4's before execution was 18 failures / 35 passes, and those historical regression controls now pass. ([Original C failing-before proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37143805691/job/111263523411), [executed lifecycle control](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179726110/job/111369660011), [original B failing-before proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142521981/job/111259728853), [54 executed historical controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179823385/job/111369946266))

### B-343-1 — a disposed purchase can still open a payable native sheet

**File:line:** `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts:330–369,720–733,975–976`. One-time creation does not recheck lifetime after its awaited POST, and the shared native flow does not recheck lifetime between awaited `initStripe`, `initPaymentSheet` and presentation. The state setter's mount guard does not guard native side effects. ([Native sequence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L308-L403), [one-time continuation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L710-L751))

**Counterexamples:** hold a one-time intent response, unmount, then resolve its secrets → native initialization/presentation still run; separately hold a subscription's sheet initialization, unmount, resolve it → presentation runs after disposal. Both actual-hook probes fail with one stale native call; this proves stale payable UI, not an executed real-provider charge. ([Two executed lifecycle failures](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179726110/job/111369660011))

**Minimal fix rule:** bind the flow to its account/session, attempt generation and live surface; revalidate those fences after every awaited backend/native operation and immediately before native initialization/presentation, retries, state/callback publication or further requests. A disposed flow must never present a sheet; preserve normal double-tap/cancellation and C-334-3 controls, and add logout/account-switch variants.

### B-343-2 — changing selected package forgets an unresolved payment's idempotency key

**File:line:** `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts:234–269,742–745,1018–1028`; selecting another package is allowed while an unknown result returns the hook to idle. A single-slot `attemptRef` means package B overwrites unresolved package A's key; returning to A creates another key while A's first confirmation may have committed. ([Single-slot key ownership](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L234-L270), [uncertain one-time attempt](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L732-L745), [selectable idle cards](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx#L287-L310))

**Counterexample:** A's native call loses its completion response, canonical purchases are not yet visible; select B and cancel its sheet; select A again → the two A POSTs carry different keys. The actual-hook assertion fails, while same-package retry and double-start controls pass; the reviewed one-time backend namespaces reservations by client/key rather than preventing a second key for the same package. ([Executed A/B/A failure and controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179726110/job/111369660011), [backend reservation key boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/6fdc35de61a26a0c9e8b3741044a3ec223dc9ab4/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L562-L646))

**Minimal fix rule:** retain outstanding attempt identity per account/package/sale-kind, including canonical recovery metadata, until authoritative completion/closure; selecting a different package must not retire an unresolved payment. Reconcile before allowing a genuinely new same-package charge; pin A-unknown/B-cancel/A and preserve purchases of different packages.

### B-343-3 — finished one-time replay has no working continuation

**File:line:** `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts:720–730`; only `PACKAGE_IS_FREE` is specially handled in this catch. A `PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_CLOSED` key is kept forever on that mounted flow, so every subsequent tap replays the closed key; completed and refunded/review outcomes also receive no existing-plan/status action, independent of P1's missing copy map. ([P2 catch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L710-L748), [current terminal-replay contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/6fdc35de61a26a0c9e8b3741044a3ec223dc9ab4/src/checkout/checkout.service.ts#L87-L154))

**Counterexample:** two successive starts after a 409 `PAYMENT_CHECKOUT_CLOSED` use the exact same dead key; the independent rotation assertion fails and no sheet opens. ([Executed dead-key failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179726110/job/111369660011))

**Minimal fix rule:** consume the three explicit replay dispositions: retire a proven closed key so an explicit next attempt works; completed → reconcile/open the existing purchase without charging again; refunded/review → show status/support without retrying the charge. Coordinate P1's B-342-2 action/copy model, retain unknown keys, and cover each hook continuation.

### B-343-4 — resumed trial charge date is parsed but never reviewed

**File:line:** `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts:935–976`, `src/components/purchase/PlanTermsBlock.tsx:24–31`. The intent carries `plan.trialEndsAt`, but reconciliation ignores it and the pre-card terms block recomputes `now + trialDays`; the backend can reuse a still-unpaid trial and return its already-pinned earlier end date. ([Ignored intent-date boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts#L930-L976), [terms renderer](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/components/purchase/PlanTermsBlock.tsx#L21-L36), [backend reuse and pinned end date](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8/src/checkout/subscription-checkout.service.ts#L1193-L1260))

**Counterexample:** a midnight-crossing retry of a 12-hour-old, seven-day trial displays a first-charge calendar date one day later than the returned subscription date, then immediately initializes SetupIntent PaymentSheet without reviewing the earlier debit/cancellation deadline. The corrected, deterministic within-window real-sheet probe executes **1 failure / 19 passing original controls**; the initial 24-hour-old fixture is not relied on for this finding. ([Executed 12-hour pinned-date failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179991390/job/111370433925))

**Minimal fix rule:** retain the displayed terms snapshot and the authoritative first-charge instant; render the pinned date, and require review/confirmation before card saving if the promised charge date/deadline changed. Do not restart or duplicate the subscription to hide the mismatch; confirm against the same attempt.

### B-343-5 — newly added payment terms fail dark-mode contrast on the selected card

**File:line:** `src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx:310,402–405`, `src/components/purchase/PlanTermsBlock.tsx:57–61`. The new first-charge/renewal body text uses dark `textMuted` `#A09B94` inside the inherited selected-card fill `#D6E4DA`, yielding **2.098:1**, below the 4.5:1 AA requirement for its 13px body text; the finding concerns this PR's newly added payment-consent text, not a request to sweep unrelated old card styles. ([New terms placement and selected fill](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx#L287-L310), [new term-text styles](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477/src/components/purchase/PlanTermsBlock.tsx#L42-L63), [executed actual-sheet style/contrast failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179872241/job/111370089032))

**Minimal fix rule:** use a theme-aware selected surface with matching foregrounds, or give the terms block its own safe surface; keep first-charge and renewal copy readable in both themes. Make the actual rendered selected-card contrast test pass, and retain visible selection affordance.

### Exact evidence / landing boundary

The probes preserve candidate runtime/config/dependency blobs: lifecycle/key run **4 failures / 30 passes**; historical recurring replay **54 original passes** (its initial 24-hour date fixture is superseded); corrected within-window date run **1 failure / 19 original passes**; dark actual-sheet render **1 contrast failure**. These are synthetic mocked network/native boundaries, not device/provider or production acceptance. ([Lifecycle/key execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179726110/job/111369660011), [historical recurring execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179823385/job/111369946266), [corrected date execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179991390/job/111370433925), [dark render execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179872241/job/111370089032))

Ordinary exact-head CI succeeds with **450 suites / 6,305 tests**; only Typecheck/lint/test runs at this stacked base, and both required CodeQL analyses remain final-main landing gates, not silently inferred successes. The piece's recurring regression suites live in later P3, so they were explicitly replayed in the audit lane; no missing-suite safety claim rests solely on green split CI. ([Exact ordinary execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152690665/job/111289631367), [stack readiness/size assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/343#issuecomment-5975774163))

Land the full stack as one after the backend chain is approved/deployed; original C-334-2's native Update-card composition remains the operator/P3 gate and does not create an unrelated P2 blocker. ([Landing instruction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/343#issuecomment-5975774163), [original composition condition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5972086092))

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#343 @ af984441a5328c9738bc12e3bdc09a44d3664477 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/1/2

Lens: Claude Opus 5.5, agent 117, AUD-OPUS-P12-117. Independent audit of split piece S2 of #334 at its exact head (base #342 @ 728214956d999e741ae65e99cee93b1ea0157385). Paired backend contract read at its current heads: #678 2174eb7c, #679 0e1cfde00f6293c0ddf4ee9e2c99f5321bbe2cb8, #680 d1c62ee100e4abd72c21295c32f8b32e450981da.

Evidence reuse (G09): the last Opus APPROVE on this code is #334 @ 0629d50601618af7a51d0f92c4bbf828001dba7a (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/334#issuecomment-5964822138). Byte-identical to that head and reused: `src/components/purchase/PlanTermsBlock.tsx`, `src/components/__tests__/PackageSelectionSheet.payment.test.tsx`, `src/config/__tests__/stripePublishableKey.test.ts`. Changed since then and audited in full: `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts` (+368/-37 vs 0629d506, FIX ROUND 3/4: B-334-3, B-334-4, C-334-3), `src/components/purchase/PurchaseFeedback.tsx` (+36/-9), `src/components/PackageSelectionSheet.tsx` (+7). All 6 files were read in full for piece-boundary safety. Not reused: any Sol evidence.

Piece boundary: compiles alone (Typecheck/lint/test green at this head, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37152690665/job/111289631367); imports only main and S1 modules, nothing from S3. This piece is live, not inert: it replaces the Day 1 sheet's buy flow, so it must not ship before the paired backend is deployed (the READY land-as-one rule covers this).

Control evidence at this exact head: the two S3 suites that test this piece's hook and sheet (`PackageSelectionSheet.recur3.test.tsx`, `PackageSelectionSheet.subscription.test.tsx`, copied unchanged from #344 f629e0f9) plus S2's own payment suite, run against af984441: 3 suites, 76 tests green, https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37180193875 (branch `audit/AUD-OPUS-P12-117/343-controls`).

## B-343-1 — `src/hooks/usePackagePurchase.ts:631-635` + `src/components/purchase/PurchaseFeedback.tsx:46-55` an unknown one-time outcome is shown as "Payment received"

When a one-time card sheet ends without a clear answer (the native call threw, timed out, or lost the connection), `settleOneTimeUnknown` sets `phase: "confirming"` while it reads the purchases. `PurchaseFeedback` maps `confirming` + `saleKind === "one_time"` to `PACKAGE_PAYMENT_COPY.confirming` = "Payment received. Setting up your plan." (`packagePayment.ts:569`). The client sees that for the whole read (up to about 10 s, `ENTITLEMENT_POLL_DELAYS_MS = [0, 1500, 2500, 3000, 3000]`) and again on every Check again (`checkAgain`, line 1079), and only then gets `outcomeUnknown` ("it is not yet clear whether this payment went through"). That is the exact claim B-334-3 forbids, made before anything is proven. New in fix round 3 (`settleOneTimeUnknown` does not exist at 0629d506), so no earlier Opus approval covers it. The subscription path is not affected: its uncertain read shows the neutral `confirmingPlan` ("Confirming your plan.").

Probe (red at this head): https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37180210458 (branch `audit/AUD-OPUS-P12-117/343-probe`, spec `src/components/__tests__/audOpusP12117.probe343.test.tsx`). One-time package, `presentPaymentSheet` rejects, the purchase read is held open: `payment-confirming` reads "Payment received. Setting up your plan." (Expected pattern: not /payment received/i).

Minimal fix rule: while a one-time outcome is unproven, the progress text is neutral (for example "Checking whether the payment went through."). Carry the distinction in state (an `uncertain` flag or a separate phase) so `PurchaseFeedback` shows "Payment received" only after Stripe confirmed the sheet. One test that fails before the fix: the probe above, plus the same assertion after Check again.

## C-343-1 — piece boundary: the tests for this piece's fix-round logic ship in #344

The suites that prove B-334-3, B-334-4 and C-334-3 in this piece's hook (`recur3`, 522 lines; `subscription`, 621 lines) import only S1/S2 modules but live in S3. At this head only `PackageSelectionSheet.payment.test.tsx` runs against the hook, so S2's own CI does not cover the subscription path. Moving them here would push S2 past the 3,000-line hard limit, so the split is reasonable; the control run above shows they pass at this head. Fix rule (default): every fix round on #343 runs those two suites against the #343 head in the CI lane and cites the run in its FIX ROUND. Operator alternative: move them into S2 and split the hook differently.

## C-343-2 — outside this diff: the iOS return URL is never handed to Stripe

The hook passes `returnURL: STRIPE_RETURN_URL` (`tgp://stripe-redirect`, `packagePayment.ts:430`) to `initPaymentSheet`, but no code calls `handleURLCallback` (no match in `src/`; `RootNavigator.tsx:473-476` handles incoming URLs for invites and resets only). Stripe's React Native subscription guide asks the root component to forward incoming URLs to the SDK (https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/build-subscriptions?payment-ui=mobile&platform=react-native). Card 3DS mostly completes in-app, so this is a device-acceptance check, not a code defect proven here. Fix rule: forward `Linking` URLs to `handleURLCallback` before the app's own deep-link handling, or record on-device 3DS (redirect challenge) acceptance on iOS before release.

## Inherited, not counted here
- B-342-1 (unconfirmed subscription-intent outcome told as "nothing was charged") lives in `src/lib/packagePayment.ts` (#342) and is fixed there. It reaches users through this hook (`usePackagePurchase.ts:925`); the same probe run 37180210458 shows it: PAYMENT_RETRY with the backend's "result is not confirmed yet" body renders "The last attempt did not finish and nothing was charged. ...". The #342 fix is enough; the probe case can then become a regression test here.
- C-334-2 (#322 composition in `ClientPackagesScreen.tsx`) belongs to #344.

## What holds (audited at this head)
- B-334-3: an unclear card answer reads the plan (`settleUncertain`) or the purchases before any copy. No-charge only on `awaiting_payment` / `awaiting_card`; paid, processing and card_saved keep reading; a failed read is "outcome unknown" with Check again, never no-charge.
- B-334-4: `reconcileIntentTerms` keeps trial days at 0 when the backend says 0 (no `||` fallback), sends `expected_one_time_cents`, and opens no chargeable sheet when trial, one-time part, currency or cadence changed; a first charge inconsistent with the adopted terms is a support notice; confirm replays the same key.
- C-334-3: `pollPlan` re-checks the mount and attempt after each read (lines 465-466); no callback after unmount.
- B-334-1 (prior Opus): SUBSCRIPTION_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED retries once with a fresh key (lines 874-906); its own copy when it repeats.
- Double taps blocked (`inFlightRef`), Skip and close blocked while busy, CTA hidden in done and price-review states, secrets stay in local variables, Sentry gets cause/step/status/code/reference only.
- Copy: no first person, no exclamation marks, no generic error text.

CI at this head: Typecheck/lint/test green (CodeQL runs once the stack is on main, as the READY says). Probe and control branches are deleted when this job ends.

## Money list self-check
